Class CaptchaImpl

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.client.CaptchaImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Captcha
public class CaptchaImpl extends Object implements Captcha
Default implementation of the Captcha interface, holding captcha image data, verification algorithm details, and the user-entered code.
